reference.name: Push Square via Exophase · supplied count and grade reference

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Collect the other 54 trophies to finish the platinum, allowing roughly 200 hours for a single playthrough. Protect Positive Mental Attitude during Chapter 1 before moving on to the long cleanup. Use the 15 manual slots to retain a chapter-start save and a separate save before the finale; the additional autosave is no replacement for these checkpoints. There is no mission replay or New Game Plus, and cheats disable both saving and trophies.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission, by following its objectives through to the end. This is an automatic story award rather than a separate exploration task. Begin your manual-save routine here so later chapters have a safe return point. No optional action within this mission is required by the supplied trophy facts.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Work through the Chapter 1 story objectives until the chapter closes; the award follows normal progression. Before advancing, make time for Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house. That separate meditation opportunity expires at the chapter boundary, although this chapter-completion trophy cannot be missed. Retain the chapter's manual save for your meditation cleanup.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Continue the main campaign through the end of Chapter 2 to receive this automatic story trophy. Make a fresh manual save when the chapter begins. Daily Driver and Moses also introduce useful garage and vehicle-registration systems during this part of the campaign, so note those unlocks for later cleanup. The trophy itself needs no optional challenge or hidden choice.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Bring Chapter 3's campaign missions to their conclusion to earn this story award. Save at the beginning of the chapter before tackling its missions and diversions. Watch for the hourglass-marked Race Against Yago and handle it immediately after saving, since that side event is time-sensitive. Chapter completion itself is automatic and has no optional trophy condition.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the main objectives of Chapter 4 and let the chapter transition complete. This trophy arrives through the campaign without an extra score requirement. Preserve a chapter-start save, and look for That's Where The Money Is near the chapter's end to open the optional bank-vault activity. Vault robberies are separate from this unmissable chapter award.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign's final mission for this gold story trophy. Set aside a dedicated manual save before starting the finale because the game offers neither mission replay nor New Game Plus. The supplied research specifies completion, with no additional ending choice or performance target. Afterward, consult the newly available 100% checklist for the remaining platinum work.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play Breakfast Run through its final objective to collect this campaign trophy. Follow the mission prompts rather than looking for a separate hidden interaction suggested by the trophy name. It is listed as an automatic story unlock with no missable requirement. Keep your chapter saves intact because completed missions cannot be replayed from a menu.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist as part of the campaign and the trophy will follow mission completion. This requirement is tied to the named mission, so ordinary bank-vault robberies do not substitute for it. There is no optional score target in the supplied facts and the award is unmissable through story progression. Maintain your chapter checkpoint before pushing further into the campaign.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: See Child's Play through to its mission-complete state. The campaign supplies this trophy automatically, so the title is not a clue to a separate family activity. No special combat result or dialogue decision is established as necessary. Continue using manual chapter checkpoints even though this particular story award has no missable condition.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners by advancing through its assigned mission objectives. This hidden trophy is revealed by normal story completion, without a separate exploration trigger. The research does not identify any optional performance requirement for the award. Keep your current chapter's manual save because there is no mission-replay feature for revisiting earlier events.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the campaign mission VCIA Takedown for this automatic unlock. Stealing a passenger plane during free exploration belongs to Catch Me If You Can and does not replace the mission requirement here. No optional stunt or particular vehicle is specified for this story award. It is not missable when following the campaign to completion.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Advance Operation Savage Glory until the mission ends successfully. Its completion is the entire verified requirement for this hidden story trophy. You do not need to seek a weather event or another activity based on the trophy's name. The award is unmissable during the campaign; preserve chapter saves for the broader platinum plan.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after finishing the story; the checklist only becomes visible then, but earlier work remains credited. Its targets include story missions, Strangers & Freaks strands, 300 stunts, all 42 range golds, eight bank vaults and 39 illegal operations. Discover 200 of the 277 vehicle models and finish 70 of 80 Challenges as well. Positive Mental Attitude has its own Chapter 1 warning, so secure that trophy while playing rather than waiting for this post-story audit.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Build a combined total of 250 completed stunts using jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Keep a record of completed opportunities while exploring so cleanup has a clear direction. The silver threshold is below the 300 stunts needed for 100%, so continue after the notification if you are pursuing A Long Road. No chapter-specific expiry is identified for this activity.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each activity category as it becomes available across Leonida. Make a simple list of the types you have tried, since repeating one favorite activity does not cover a new type. The research does not provide an exhaustive venue list or confirm a specific finishing score for every category. No exclusive chapter window is established, so revisit remaining types during cleanup.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit both shooting ranges and upgrade every challenge result to gold, for 42 gold medals overall. Track the two ranges separately so a completed set at one does not hide unfinished work at the other. A silver or bronze result needs improving before this trophy can unlock. These same gold medals contribute to 100% completion, and no chapter cutoff is documented.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Earn a Top Fun Drone Race victory at each of the 14 locations. Log the venue after each win so repeated victories at the same course do not obscure the locations you still need. Participation alone does not meet the winning requirement. The supplied facts do not specify a compulsory route order or a chapter deadline for these races.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Record wins in twenty distinct races, choosing a new event after each successful finish. Repeating the same course is not a substitute for the required variety. During Chapter 3, save before Race Against Yago and enter it as soon as its hourglass marker appears because that opportunity is time-sensitive. This trophy is not otherwise designated missable by the supplied list.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal's fishing challenge and finish with a winning result. Follow the challenge's displayed rules rather than treating ordinary fishing as sufficient. The supplied research does not establish an exact bait choice, fishing spot or winning catch count, so those details remain unconfirmed. No unique chapter deadline is listed for this trophy.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Choose an arcade game and play it to completion rather than simply starting a session. Use that game's own instructions to understand its end condition. A mandatory cabinet, score or exploit is not confirmed in the provided research, so this guide does not prescribe one. The trophy has no documented chapter-limited opportunity and can remain on your activity cleanup list.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's mission sequence until his final job is finished. The trophy belongs to the conclusion of that character's strand, not the first meeting or an intermediate mission. Andy's quests have this separate award and do not count toward the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks. No optional ending condition or exclusive chapter deadline is supplied for this unlock.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Continue taking Kenton's missions until you complete the last one in his sequence. This award is tied to that final mission's completion rather than a free-roam boating stunt. The supplied facts do not demand a specific score or optional objective along the way. It is not flagged missable, but keeping chapter saves remains useful because there is no mission replay.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's jobs in sequence and finish his closing mission for this hidden award. Merely beginning his questline leaves the trophy unfinished. Treat Billy's strand as a separate platinum task: it does not contribute to the eight qualifying strands required by Strangers & Freaks. No additional missable condition is identified for the final mission in the provided research.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger questlines across Leonida, counting whole strands rather than individual jobs. Exclude Andy, Billy and Tyrone from your tally because their lines have separate trophies. In Chapter 3, make a save and tackle Race Against Yago the moment its hourglass marker becomes available. That event is time-sensitive; the trophy itself is not listed as the guide's sole missable award.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Carry Randy's mission chain through to its final assignment and complete that job. The award is for the end of his storyline, so ordinary trading or money-making activities are not the stated trigger. No special mission grade or optional route is confirmed as necessary. It is not flagged missable in the research, and manual chapter saves provide a fallback while progressing.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's assignments to the end and complete his final mission. His trophy is a character-story completion award with no separate stunt requirement established by the research. Do not add this questline to your Strangers & Freaks count, because Tyrone is excluded from that eight-strand target. No chapter-specific expiration is listed for this award.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete meditation at all 18 locations, securing the Chapter 1 balcony first. Once Lucia is home, visit the kitchen in the morning and follow her onto the balcony at Jason's house. Meditate before Chapter 1 closes; that opportunity disappears afterward. Hold onto a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy unlocks, since neither mission replay nor New Game Plus can recover it. An unconfirmed report says outdoor meditation with your partner may count twice. Bring them if convenient, but still check every location instead of relying on that report.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Use Jason for Bret's hunting questline and hunt one of its unique animals. Aim for a clean shot to the head or heart to preserve a pristine carcass. The supplied facts do not identify a mandatory first animal or a precise spawn schedule, so follow Bret's available objectives. No chapter-limited missable condition is established for this trophy.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Gather cards until you have completed three full Collectible Card sets. Organize your notes by set so a large number of loose cards does not look like three completed collections. The provided research confirms the set count but does not give a verified card-by-card location route. No disappearing chapter opportunity is documented for this collection trophy.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at one hundred locations while traveling through Leonida. Record each location you finish so later trips can concentrate on places still missing from your collection. A complete verified location map is not included in the supplied research, and this guide does not invent one. No chapter cutoff is specified, allowing this task to sit alongside exploration cleanup.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Challenges and finish fifty of the listed objectives. Use that menu to choose unfinished tasks that fit your current route instead of repeating already completed challenges. The trophy unlocks before the 100% target, which calls for seventy of the eighty available Challenges. No exclusive chapter deadline is identified for this award in the supplied facts.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner, reach a four-star Wanted Level and complete the escape from both the police and the remaining heat. Keep the partnership together through the getaway. A bank-vault escape with your partner can earn this alongside the vault activity, making it a useful combined objective. No unique chapter window is listed; vault access itself opens near the end of Chapter 4.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner before starting, then rob three shops in one continuous wanted streak. Move directly between shops and keep active wanted stars throughout the chain. A red heat zone alone is insufficient once those stars disappear, so that situation requires another attempt. After the third robbery, allow roughly thirty seconds for the trophy notification. No chapter-specific cutoff is reported.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover one hundred vehicles, using the WAiNK app to scan models you encounter on your travels. Scanning counts, so you do not have to build a garage collection of every discovery. Keep looking for unfamiliar base models after this trophy because 100% completion requires two hundred of the 277 models. No chapter-specific loss of access is identified for the trophy.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Find a group of at least five enemies and prepare an assault rifle before activating Combat Focus. While aiming, press L3 + R3 to slow the action, then take down five enemies before that single activation ends. Adrenaline can extend the available Focus time if you need more room to finish the group. No mission-specific or chapter-limited encounter is required by the provided facts.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make a manual save before entering Vice City International Airport because the police response is quick. Steal a large passenger aircraft parked at a boarding bridge; gates E3 and E4 are reported working choices. Take off and travel about one kilometer away from the airport to trigger the award. No chapter expiration is established, so prepare the attempt when you can handle the escape.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the far southwest of the map. Look along the base's south side for parked military tanks and get inside one. The verified condition is entering the tank; no destruction quota is supplied. Save before testing your approach, and treat any exact entry route as unconfirmed. This trophy is not marked missable.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to obtain the Snap Gun and open jewelry robberies. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a suitable target: use the Snap Gun on the locked rear door instead of kicking it and triggering the alarm. Search the back room for the safe-code note, empty the safe and leave without detection. No exclusive chapter cutoff is listed after the activity unlocks.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Near the end of Chapter 4, complete the optional That's Where The Money Is mission to gain access to vault robberies. Follow an armored van to a large bank, then enter while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner because one character cannot carry all the bags, and finish five robberies with successful escapes. A partnered vault getaway also earns Hot Together. Continue to eight vaults for 100%; no later chapter cutoff is identified.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and complete the escape afterward. Plan a getaway before committing so taking the loot is followed by a successful exit from the pursuit. The supplied facts do not confirm a compulsory truck location, weapon or ambush method, so use the available in-game instructions. No chapter-specific window is established for this activity trophy.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Cover Leonida while combining travel with vehicle discoveries, WAiNK locations and other cleanup tasks. Keep notes on areas you have not visited so the final exploration pass has a purpose. The exact map-reveal percentage and any required altitude are unconfirmed in the supplied research. No disappearing chapter opportunity is identified for exploring the state.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Choose Illegal Operations owned by different gangs until all nine gangs are represented in your completed robberies. Track the owner as well as the location, since repeated jobs against one gang leave the other gangs unfinished. For the 100% route, continue beyond this trophy to complete all 39 operations. No chapter-limited opportunity is specified for the gang coverage requirement.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Investigate cocktail interactions on Ocean Beach, following the official clue about enjoying a view. The supplied research does not pin down the venue, seat or time required for the unlock. Save before trying a likely interaction and check whether the trophy appears, rather than treating an assumed location as verified. This award is not designated missable.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The official clue points to breaking out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. A verified showroom address, vehicle choice and exact sequence are not available in the supplied facts. Keep a manual save before exploring that clue and wait for an actual trophy notification before marking it complete. No exclusive chapter deadline has been established for this trophy.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bring Sticky Bombs to Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates operation introduced in Chapter 2. Collect the office's luxury watch and the shotgun lying on a table, then blast open the office safe with a Sticky Bomb and take its contents. Escape the police with all three key valuables collected. Leaving something behind does not permanently lose the trophy because the operation becomes available again later.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Purchase a gym membership and bring your partner along for training. Your companion trains beside you, helping raise Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Verify that both characters have reached maximum Strength before considering the task finished; maxing only one is insufficient. The provided research identifies no exclusive chapter window for this training trophy.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Accumulate five hundred actions that alter your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights provide qualifying opportunities, so combine this counter with other criminal activities on your checklist. Watch for actual profile changes because the supplied facts do not guarantee that every repeated input contributes. No chapter-specific cutoff is identified for reaching this cumulative total.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The official description supplies a second-attempt clue but does not identify the underlying event. A reliable action sequence and location remain unconfirmed in the research provided for this guide. Preserve your chapter checkpoints and do not spend resources on a guessed method presented as fact. The supplied list does not flag this trophy as missable.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The unlock method remains unconfirmed in the supplied research. The mysterious official description does not establish a place, time or repeatable interaction to follow. Keep chapter saves while exploring, and leave the trophy unchecked until it actually unlocks instead of relying on speculative UFO instructions. It is not marked as a missable trophy in the provided list.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Use the official melee drive-by clue as the starting point for this hidden trophy. The supplied facts do not verify a target count, required vehicle or exact control sequence, so a tested route cannot be claimed here. Save before experimenting and confirm the award through the trophy notification. No chapter-exclusive opportunity is documented for this condition.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Collect Marked Bills from bank jobs and payday loan robberies, then use your contacts to launder them. Continue until the cumulative laundering earnings reach $250,000. Track the proceeds from laundering rather than your current cash balance, since spending money does not describe the trophy's counter. No single transaction size or chapter deadline is specified by the supplied facts.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Build up $100,000 in cumulative shop spending, with purchases across shop types contributing to the total. Buy useful supplies for other activities as you progress and check the remaining spending during cleanup. You do not need to retain that amount in your wallet or make one enormous purchase. No chapter-exclusive buying window is identified in the research.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app, then buy its eight garage properties. Set aside roughly $160,000 for the complete purchase list. Garages awarded by the story do not satisfy these purchases. Buying early also creates space for the ten registrations in On the Spot. No exclusive chapter deadline is documented once the app becomes available.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Complete Moses in Chapter 2, then bring a stolen car to Moses and select Respray followed by Register. Beginning in Chapter 3, installing a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray offers another registration route. Buy garage space first because each of the ten registered vehicles needs an empty slot; inexpensive cars are sufficient. No chapter cutoff is specified after registration becomes available.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

editorial: Guides written for Leonida Field Guide from the supplied research. Exact trophy wording is retained; uncertain unlock details are identified in each guide.
